An '''OOM pilot battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] [[Grievous's Munificent-class star frigate (suspected Confederate space)/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and participated in the [[Mission to suspected Confederate space/Legends|ambush]] on [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in Confederate space in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
